def fetch(url, path, headers=None, timeout=300):
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers=headers or {"User-Agent": UA["User-Agent"]})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout) as r, open(path + ".part", "wb") as f:
        while True:
            b = r.read(1 << 20)
            if not b: break
            f.write(b)
    os.replace(path + ".part", path)

def bk_file(key):

    p = os.path.join(ADIR, "bk_" + aid + ".blend")
    if os.path.exists(p) and os.path.getsize(p) > 1000: return p
    errs = []
    for host_url in [durl, durl.replace("www.blenderkit.com", "api.blenderkit.com")]:
        try:
            h = dict(UA); h["Authorization"] = "Bearer " + KEY
            q = host_url + "?" + urllib.parse.urlencode({"scene_uuid": str(uuid.uuid4())})
            r = urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(q, headers=h), timeout=60)
            fp = json.loads(r.read().decode())["filePath"]
            fetch(fp, p)
            return p
        except Exception as e:
            errs.append(type(e).__name__ + ":" + str(getattr(e, "code", ""))[:6])
    NOTES.append("BK " + key + " " + "/".join(errs))
    return None

        try: fetch(PH + "HDRIs/hdr/%s/%s_%s.hdr" % (res, name, res), p)
        except Exception: NOTES.append("PH hdri " + name); return None
    return p

def load_objs(key, coll_name=None):
    """append all renderable objects of a Blendkit file into a new scene collection; returns (collection, objects, top-level objects)"""
    p = bk_file(key)
    if not p: return None
    with bpy.data.libraries.load(p, link=False) as (df, dt):
        dt.objects = list(df.objects)
    coll = bpy.data.collections.new(coll_name or ("BK_" + key))
    bpy.context.scene.collection.children.link(coll)
    objs = []
    for o in dt.objects:
        if o is None: continue
        if o.type in ("CAMERA", "LIGHT"): continue
        if o.hide_render and o.type != "ARMATURE": continue
        coll.objects.link(o); objs.append(o)
    names = set(o.name for o in objs)
    tops = [o for o in objs if o.parent is None or o.parent.name not in names]
    return coll, objs, tops

def bbox(objs):
    mn = Vector((1e9, 1e9, 1e9)); mx = Vector((-1e9, -1e9, -1e9))
    dg = bpy.context.evaluated_depsgraph_get()
    for o in objs:
        if o.type != "MESH": continue
        for c in o.bound_box:

            mn = Vector((min(mn.x, w.x), min(mn.y, w.y), min(mn.z, w.z)))
            mx = Vector((max(mx.x, w.x), max(mx.y, w.y), max(mx.z, w.z)))
    return mn, mx

# Generic rig posing for arbitrary humanoid armatures (Mixamo / Rigify DEF / custom).
# Poses are given in CHARACTER space (character faces -Y, +X = character's left, +Z up).
import re, math
from mathutils import Vector, Matrix, Quaternion, Euler

SIDE_L = re.compile(r"(^|[^a-z])(left|l)([^a-z]|$)|\.l(\.|$)|_l(_|$|\.)|^l_|left", re.I)
SIDE_R = re.compile(r"(^|[^a-z])(right|r)([^a-z]|$)|\.r(\.|$)|_r(_|$|\.)|^r_|right", re.I)

def clean(n):
    n = n.lower()
    for p in ["mixamorig:", "mixamorig_", "def-", "def_", "cc_base_", "bip01_", "bip01 ", "b_", "jnt_"]:
        if n.startswith(p): n = n[len(p):]
    return n

def side(n):
    c = n.lower()
    if "left" in c: return "L"
    if "right" in c: return "R"
    if re.search(r"(\.|_|-)l(\.\d+)?$", c) or re.search(r"^l(_|\.)", c) or re.search(r"(_|\.)l(_|\.)", c): return "L"
    if re.search(r"(\.|_|-)r(\.\d+)?$", c) or re.search(r"^r(_|\.)", c) or re.search(r"(_|\.)r(_|\.)", c): return "R"
    return ""

def role(n):
    c = clean(n)
    if re.match(r"spine\.00[45]$", c): return "neck"
    if c == "spine.006": return "head"
    if "forehead" in c or "temple" in c or "chin" in c: return None
    cx = c.replace("forearm", "fa_rm").replace("fore_arm", "fa_rm")
    if any(k in cx for k in ["finger", "thumb", "index", "middle", "ring", "pinky", "toe", "eye", "jaw", "teeth", "tongue", "twist", "breast", "hair", "brow", "lid", "lip", "cheek", "nose", "ear", "roll", "pole", "ik", "tweak", "mch", "org", "socket", "prop", "weapon", "end"]):
        return None
    s = side(n)
    if re.search(r"fore_?arm|lower_?arm|lowerarm|elbow", c): r = "fa"
    elif re.search(r"upper_?arm|^arm|leftarm|rightarm|(^|[^a-z])arm([^a-z]|$)", c) and "fore" not in c: r = "ua"
    elif re.search(r"shoulder|clavicle|collar", c): r = "sh"
    elif re.search(r"hand|wrist", c): r = "hd"
    elif re.search(r"thigh|up_?leg|upper_?leg|upleg", c): r = "th"
    elif re.search(r"shin|calf|lower_?leg|knee|(^|[^a-z])leg([^a-z]|$)|leftleg|rightleg", c): r = "sn"
    elif re.search(r"foot|ankle", c): r = "ft"
    elif re.search(r"neck", c): return "neck"
    elif re.search(r"head", c): return "head"
    elif re.search(r"spine|chest|torso|abdomen|^back", c): return "spine"
    elif re.search(r"hips|pelvis", c) and not s: return "hips"
    else: return None
    return r + s if s else None

class Rig:
    def __init__(self, arm, base_rot=None):
        """arm: armature object. base_rot: 3x3 rotation from armature space to character space (default from current matrix_world)."""
        self.arm = arm
        mw = arm.matrix_world.to_3x3().normalized() if base_rot is None else base_rot
        self.B = mw; self.Bi = mw.inverted()
        bones = arm.data.bones
        self.rest = {b.name: b.matrix_local.to_3x3().normalized() for b in bones}
        self.parent = {b.name: (b.parent.name if b.parent else None) for b in bones}
        # hierarchy order
        order = []
        def rec(b):
            order.append(b.name)
            for c in b.children: rec(c)
        for b in bones:
            if b.parent is None: rec(b)
        self.order = order
        # deform-only mapping when DEF bones exist (rigify); else all
        has_def = any(n.lower().startswith("def-") for n in order)
        self.map = {}
        spines = []
        for n in order:
            if has_def and not n.lower().startswith("def-"): continue
            if not has_def and not bones[n].use_deform: continue
            r = role(n)
            if r is None: continue
            if r == "spine":
                spines.append(n); continue
            if r not in self.map: self.map[r] = n
        self.spines = spines[:4]
        # remove constraints and drivers so FK posing works
        for pb in arm.pose.bones:
            for c in list(pb.constraints): pb.constraints.remove(c)
            pb.rotation_mode = "QUATERNION"
        if arm.animation_data:
            arm.animation_data.action = None
            for d in list(arm.animation_data.drivers):
                try: arm.animation_data.drivers.remove(d)
                except Exception: pass
        self.keyed = [n for n in [self.map.get(k) for k in self.map] if n] + self.spines
        need = set()
        for n in self.keyed:
            while n is not None and n not in need:
                need.add(n); n = self.parent[n]
        self.order = [n for n in order if n in need]

    def solve(self, pose):
        """pose: dict. limbs 'uaL','faL','hdL','thL','snL','ftL' (+R) -> direction Vector in character space.
        'spine','neck','head','hips' -> (x,y,z) degrees euler in character space."""
        P = {}; L = {}
        inv_map = {v: k for k, v in self.map.items()}
        nsp = max(1, len(self.spines))
        for n in self.order:
            par = self.parent[n]
            R = self.rest[n]
            if par is None: P0 = R.copy()
            else: P0 = P[par] @ (self.rest[par].inverted() @ R)
            key = inv_map.get(n)
            Q = None
            if n in self.spines and "spine" in pose:
                e = pose["spine"]; Q = Euler([math.radians(a) / nsp for a in e]).to_matrix()
            elif key in ("neck", "head", "hips") and key in pose:
                e = pose[key]; Q = Euler([math.radians(a) for a in e]).to_matrix()
            elif key and key in pose:
                d = Vector(pose[key]).normalized()
                da = (self.Bi @ d).normalized()
                y0 = P0.col[1].normalized()
                Q = y0.rotation_difference(da).to_matrix()
            if Q is not None:
                if key in ("neck", "head", "hips") or n in self.spines:
                    Q = self.Bi @ Q @ self.B
                Pn = Q @ P0
                L[n] = (P0.inverted() @ Pn).to_quaternion()
            else:
                Pn = P0
            P[n] = Pn
        return L

    def apply(self, pose, frame=None):
        L = self.solve(pose)
        pbs = self.arm.pose.bones
        for n in self.keyed:
            q = L.get(n, Quaternion())
            pbs[n].rotation_quaternion = q
            if frame is not None: pbs[n].keyframe_insert("rotation_quaternion", frame=frame)

MATS = {}
def mat(name, col=(0.8, 0.8, 0.8), rough=0.5, metal=0.0, emit=None, es=1.0, coat=0.0, alpha=None, trans=0.0):
    if name in MATS: return MATS[name]
    m = bpy.data.materials.new(name); m.use_nodes = True
    b = m.node_tree.nodes.get("Principled BSDF")
    b.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = (*col, 1)
    b.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = rough
    b.inputs["Metallic"].default_value = metal
    try: b.inputs["Coat Weight"].default_value = coat
    except Exception: pass
    if trans:
        try: b.inputs["Transmission Weight"].default_value = trans
        except Exception: pass
    if emit:
        b.inputs["Emission Color"].default_value = (*emit, 1)
        b.inputs["Emission Strength"].default_value = es
    if alpha is not None:
        b.inputs["Alpha"].default_value = alpha
        try: m.surface_render_method = "BLENDED"
        except Exception: pass
    MATS[name] = m
    return m

def bsdf(m): return m.node_tree.nodes.get("Principled BSDF")

def texmat(name, tex, scale=1.0, tint=(1, 1, 1), rough_mul=1.0, bump=1.0, coat=0.0):
    if name in MATS: return MATS[name]
    m = bpy.data.materials.new(name); m.use_nodes = True
    nt = m.node_tree; N = nt.nodes; L = nt.links
    b = N.get("Principled BSDF")
    try: b.inputs["Coat Weight"].default_value = coat
    except Exception: pass
    tc = N.new("ShaderNodeTexCoord"); mp = N.new("ShaderNodeMapping")
    mp.inputs["Scale"].default_value = (scale, scale, scale)
    L.new(tc.outputs["Object"], mp.inputs["Vector"])
    def img(kind, noncolor):
        p = ph_tex(tex, kind)
        if not p: return None
        n = N.new("ShaderNodeTexImage"); n.image = bpy.data.images.load(p, check_existing=True)
        n.projection = "BOX"; n.projection_blend = 0.25
        if noncolor: n.image.colorspace_settings.name = "Non-Color"
        L.new(mp.outputs["Vector"], n.inputs["Vector"]); return n
    d = img("diff", False)
    if d:
        mix = N.new("ShaderNodeMix"); mix.data_type = "RGBA"; mix.blend_type = "MULTIPLY"
        mix.inputs["Factor"].default_value = 1.0
        L.new(d.outputs["Color"], mix.inputs[6]); mix.inputs[7].default_value = (*tint, 1)
        L.new(mix.outputs[2], b.inputs["Base Color"])
    else:
        b.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = (*tint, 1)
    r = img("rough", True)
    if r:
        mr = N.new("ShaderNodeMath"); mr.operation = "MULTIPLY"; mr.inputs[1].default_value = rough_mul
        L.new(r.outputs["Color"], mr.inputs[0]); L.new(mr.outputs[0], b.inputs["Roughness"])
    n = img("nor_gl", True)
    if n:
        nm = N.new("ShaderNodeNormalMap"); nm.inputs["Strength"].default_value = bump
        L.new(n.outputs["Color"], nm.inputs["Color"]); L.new(nm.outputs["Normal"], b.inputs["Normal"])
    MATS[name] = m
    return m

def imgmat(name, path, rough=0.6, emit_strength=0.0):
    if name in MATS: return MATS[name]
    m = bpy.data.materials.new(name); m.use_nodes = True
    N = m.node_tree.nodes; L = m.node_tree.links; b = N.get("Principled BSDF")
    b.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = rough
    if path and os.path.exists(path):
        t = N.new("ShaderNodeTexImage"); t.image = bpy.data.images.load(path, check_existing=True)
        L.new(t.outputs["Color"], b.inputs["Base Color"])
        if emit_strength:
            L.new(t.outputs["Color"], b.inputs["Emission Color"]); b.inputs["Emission Strength"].default_value = emit_strength
    else:
        b.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = (0.35, 0.5, 0.35, 1); NOTES.append("noimg " + name)
    MATS[name] = m
    return m

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- mesh helpers
def mk(name, bm, m=None, loc=(0, 0, 0), rot=(0, 0, 0), smooth=False, parent=None):
    me = bpy.data.meshes.new(name); bm.to_mesh(me); bm.free()
    if smooth:
        for p in me.polygons: p.use_smooth = True
    o = bpy.data.objects.new(name, me)
    if m: o.data.materials.append(m)
    o.location = loc; o.rotation_euler = rot
    if parent: o.parent = parent
    return link(o)

def box(name, size, loc, m=None, bevel=0.0, rot=(0, 0, 0), parent=None, seg=2):
    bm = bmesh.new(); bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm, size=1.0)
    for v in bm.verts: v.co = Vector((v.co.x * size[0], v.co.y * size[1], v.co.z * size[2]))
    o = mk(name, bm, m, loc, rot, parent=parent)
    if bevel > 0:
        b = o.modifiers.new("bv", "BEVEL"); b.width = bevel; b.segments = seg; b.limit_method = "ANGLE"
        for p in o.data.polygons: p.use_smooth = True
    return o

def cyl(name, r, h, loc, m=None, seg=32, rot=(0, 0, 0), r2=None, parent=None, smooth=True):
    bm = bmesh.new()
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm, cap_ends=True, cap_tris=False, segments=seg, radius1=r, radius2=(r if r2 is None else r2), depth=h)
    return mk(name, bm, m, loc, rot, smooth=smooth, parent=parent)

def sphere(name, rad, loc, m=None, scale=(1, 1, 1), parent=None, seg=(32, 16)):
    bm = bmesh.new(); bmesh.ops.create_uvsphere(bm, u_segments=seg[0], v_segments=seg[1], radius=rad)
    for v in bm.verts: v.co = Vector((v.co.x * scale[0], v.co.y * scale[1], v.co.z * scale[2]))
    return mk(name, bm, m, loc, smooth=True, parent=parent)

def plane(name, w, h, loc, m=None, rot=(0, 0, 0), parent=None, uv=True):
    bm = bmesh.new()
    vs = [bm.verts.new((x * w / 2, y * h / 2, 0)) for (x, y) in [(-1, -1), (1, -1), (1, 1), (-1, 1)]]
    f = bm.faces.new(vs)
    if uv:
        lay = bm.loops.layers.uv.new("UVMap")
        for lp, c in zip(f.loops, [(0, 0), (1, 0), (1, 1), (0, 1)]): lp[lay].uv = c
    return mk(name, bm, m, loc, rot, parent=parent)

def empty(name, loc=(0, 0, 0), rot=(0, 0, 0), parent=None):
    o = bpy.data.objects.new(name, None); o.location = loc; o.rotation_euler = rot; o.empty_display_size = 0.05
    if parent: o.parent = parent
    return link(o)

def light(name, kind, loc, energy, col=(1, 0.8, 0.6), size=0.1, rot=(0, 0, 0), spot=None, shadow=True):
    ld = bpy.data.lights.new(name, kind); ld.energy = energy; ld.color = col
    if kind in ("POINT", "SPOT"): ld.shadow_soft_size = size
    if kind == "AREA": ld.size = size
    if kind == "SUN": ld.angle = size
    if spot: ld.spot_size = math.radians(spot); ld.spot_blend = 0.6
    try: ld.use_shadow = shadow
    except Exception: pass
    o = bpy.data.objects.new(name, ld); o.location = loc; o.rotation_euler = rot
    return link(o)

def aim(o, target):
    d = Vector(target) - o.location
    o.rotation_euler = d.to_track_quat("-Z", "Y").to_euler()

def text(name, body, loc, size, m, rot=(D(90), 0, 0), extrude=0.0, align="CENTER"):
    cu = bpy.data.curves.new(name, "FONT"); cu.body = body; cu.size = size; cu.extrude = extrude
    cu.align_x = align; cu.align_y = "CENTER"
    o = bpy.data.objects.new(name, cu); o.location = loc; o.rotation_euler = rot
    cu.materials.append(m)
    return link(o)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- Blendkit placement
ASSET = {}
def load_asset(key):
    if key in ASSET: return ASSET[key]
    p = bk_file(key)
    if not p: ASSET[key] = None; return None
    try:
        with bpy.data.libraries.load(p, link=False) as (df, dt):
            dt.objects = list(df.objects)
        coll = bpy.data.collections.new("BK_" + key)
        mn = Vector((1e9, 1e9, 1e9)); mx = Vector((-1e9, -1e9, -1e9))
        for o in dt.objects:
            if o is None or o.type in ("CAMERA", "LIGHT") or o.hide_render: continue
            if any(k in o.name.lower() for k in ("logo", "badge", "emblem", "decal", "brand", "licen", "plate_num", "numberplate", "sticker")):
                continue
            coll.objects.link(o)
        for o in coll.objects:
            if o.type != "MESH": continue
            for c in o.bound_box:
                w = o.matrix_world @ Vector(c)
                mn = Vector((min(mn.x, w.x), min(mn.y, w.y), min(mn.z, w.z))); mx = Vector((max(mx.x, w.x), max(mx.y, w.y), max(mx.z, w.z)))
        if mn.x > 1e8: raise RuntimeError("no mesh")
        coll.instance_offset = ((mn.x + mx.x) / 2, (mn.y + mx.y) / 2, mn.z)
        ASSET[key] = (coll, mx - mn)
    except Exception as e:
        NOTES.append("load " + key + " " + type(e).__name__); ASSET[key] = None
    return ASSET[key]

FALLBACK = None
def place(key, loc, rotz=0.0, height=None, width=None, length=None, name=None, fallback=(0.3, 0.3, 0.3), fit=None):
    a = load_asset(key)
    if a is None:
        sz = fallback
        return box(name or ("fb_" + key), sz, (loc[0], loc[1], loc[2] + sz[2] / 2), mat("fallback", (0.5, 0.1, 0.1)), rot=(0, 0, rotz))
    coll, dims = a
    s = 1.0
    if height: s = height / max(dims.z, 1e-4)
    elif width: s = width / max(dims.x, 1e-4)
    elif length: s = length / max(dims.y, 1e-4)
    elif fit: s = fit / max(dims.x, dims.y, 1e-4)
    o = bpy.data.objects.new(name or ("i_" + key), None)
    o.instance_type = "COLLECTION"; o.instance_collection = coll
    o.location = loc; o.rotation_euler = (0, 0, rotz); o.scale = (s, s, s)
    return link(o)

def gable_house(name, cx, cy, w, d, h, wallm, face=1, windows=2, warm=True, roofm=None):
    """simple detached house; face=+1 front faces +y"""
    box(name + "_body", (w, d, h), (cx, cy, h / 2), wallm)
    bm = bmesh.new(); hw, hd = w / 2 + 0.3, d / 2 + 0.3
    vs = [bm.verts.new(v) for v in [(-hw, -hd, 0), (hw, -hd, 0), (hw, hd, 0), (-hw, hd, 0), (-hw, 0, 2.0), (hw, 0, 2.0)]]
    bm.faces.new([vs[0], vs[1], vs[5], vs[4]]); bm.faces.new([vs[2], vs[3], vs[4], vs[5]]); bm.faces.new([vs[0], vs[4], vs[3]]); bm.faces.new([vs[1], vs[2], vs[5]])
    mk(name + "_roof", bm, roofm or mat("roofm2", (0.12, 0.07, 0.06), 0.7), (cx, cy, h))
    fy = cy + face * (d / 2 + 0.01)
    for k in range(windows):
        x = cx - w / 4 + k * (w / 2) if windows == 2 else cx
        plane(name + "_win%d" % k, 1.2, 1.3, (x, fy, 1.6), WARMWIN if warm else DARKWIN, rot=(D(90), 0, 0 if face > 0 else D(180)))
    box(name + "_door", (1.0, 0.06, 2.1), (cx + w / 2 - 1.0, fy, 1.05), mat("doorm", (0.25, 0.12, 0.08), 0.5))

def ik_arm(c, side, target_c, hint):
    """2-bone IK in character space; returns (ua_dir, fa_dir)"""
    S = c["sh"][side]; L1, L2 = c["L1"][side], c["L2"][side]
    Tg = Vector(target_c); d = Tg - S; dist = d.length
    dist = max(0.05, min(dist, (L1 + L2) * 0.999))
    u = d.normalized()
    a = math.acos(max(-1, min(1, (L1 * L1 + dist * dist - L2 * L2) / (2 * L1 * dist))))
    h = Vector(hint); w = h - u * h.dot(u)
    if w.length < 1e-4: w = Vector((0, 0, -1)) - u * (-u.z)
    w.normalize()
    E = S + L1 * (math.cos(a) * u + math.sin(a) * w)
    Tg2 = S + u * dist
    return tuple(E - S), tuple(Tg2 - E)

def cam_basis(pos, tgt):
    f = (Vector(tgt) - Vector(pos)).normalized()
    r = f.cross(Vector((0, 0, 1)))
    if r.length < 1e-6: r = Vector((1, 0, 0))
    r.normalize(); u = r.cross(f)
    return r, u, f

def project(p, pos, r, u, f, lens):
    d = Vector(p) - Vector(pos); z = d.dot(f)
    if z <= 0.01: return None
    s = lens / (T.SENSOR / 2)
    return [round(T.W / 2 + d.dot(r) / z * s * T.H / 2, 1), round(T.H / 2 - d.dot(u) / z * s * T.H / 2, 1)]

def phone_matrix(mode, vst, c, t):
    """world matrix for the victim phone given its holding mode"""
    loc, yaw = vst["loc"], vst["yaw"]
    if mode == "table":
        p = phone_table_pos(t)
        rz = D(-12) + (0.06 * math.sin(t * 70) if 10.84 <= t < 12.3 else 0)
        return Matrix.Translation(p) @ Matrix.Rotation(rz, 4, "Z")
    if mode in ("earL",):
        e = Vector(ear_target(c, "L", loc, yaw)) + Matrix.Rotation(yaw, 3, "Z") @ Vector((0.012, 0.03, -0.02))
        R = Matrix.Rotation(yaw, 4, "Z") @ Matrix.Rotation(D(-90), 4, "Y") @ Matrix.Rotation(D(-20), 4, "Z") @ Matrix.Rotation(D(25), 4, "X")
        return Matrix.Translation(e) @ R
    if mode in ("handL", "handL_low", "qr", "handL_flat"):
        tw = vst["ik"]["L"][0]
        if mode == "qr":
            p = Vector(T.QR) + Vector((0.0, 0.05, 0.0))
            return Matrix.Translation(p) @ Matrix.Rotation(D(-90), 4, "X")    # screen faces the scanner (-y)
        if mode == "handL_flat":
            return Matrix.Translation(Vector(tw) + Vector((0, 0, -0.03))) @ Matrix.Rotation(D(-8), 4, "Z")
        head = to_world(c, (c["head"].x, c["head"].y, c["head"].z + 0.08), loc, yaw)
        p = Vector(tw) + Matrix.Rotation(yaw, 3, "Z") @ Vector((-0.04, -0.02, 0.05))
        z = (Vector(head) - p).normalized()            # screen normal toward the eyes
        y = (Vector((0, 0, 1)) - z * z.z).normalized()
        x = y.cross(z)
        R = Matrix((x, y, z)).transposed().to_4x4()
        return Matrix.Translation(p) @ R
    return Matrix.Translation((0, 0, HIDE_Z))

    pts = BEAM_PTS
    segs = [(pts[i + 1] - pts[i]).length for i in range(len(pts) - 1)]
    L = sum(segs) * max(0, min(1, k))
    for i, s in enumerate(segs):
        if L <= s: return pts[i].lerp(pts[i + 1], L / s)
        L -= s
    return pts[-1]

def fcurves_of(idb):
    ad = getattr(idb, "animation_data", None)
    if not ad or not ad.action: return []
    act = ad.action
    try: return list(act.fcurves)
    except Exception: pass
    out = []
    try:
        for layer in act.layers:
            for strip in layer.strips:
                try:

                    if cb: out += list(cb.fcurves)
                except Exception: pass
    except Exception: pass
